source: DOF Parking Violations Issued FY2020-FY2027, camera codes excluded. Exact aggregation reconciled row-for-row to the City’s totals for all eight fiscal years. Each distinct address placed by LION address ranges; addresses without a usable house number, or whose number falls outside LION’s ranges, are placed per layer wherever every segment of the named street agrees on the district. The remainder per layer per year is stored and shown; it reflects records this matching could not resolve, not a limit of the data.
